---
title: "QoL unadjusted landmark — computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)
uses the death-as-state-8 week-26 landmark without covariate adjustment. It
uses fixed imputations 1–5 and retains 200 posterior draws per imputation.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))
runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
indices <- module_exact_indices(config, supporting = TRUE)
if (!identical(indices, 1:5)) stop("Supporting unadjusted landmark requires exactly imputations 1:5.")
data_dir <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "imputations")
death_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "death-inclusive-prepared.parquet")
output_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "supporting", "qol-unadjusted-landmark"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-unadjusted-landmark
#| include: false
for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(data_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  model_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  draws_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(data_path) || !file.exists(death_path)) stop("QoL landmark inputs are incomplete for imputation ", index, ".")
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("supporting-qol-unadjusted-landmark-%02d", index),
    input_paths = c(data_path, death_path),
    output_paths = c(model_path, draws_path),
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(label = "computationally reduced supporting/sensitivity analysis (5 imputations)",
                   imputation = index, imputations = 1:5, posterior_draws = 200L,
                   death_state = 8L, adjusted = FALSE),
    worker = function() {
      data <- module_read_parquet(data_path)
      death <- module_read_parquet(death_path)
      latest <- data[data$week == 26L, c("id", "tx"), drop = FALSE]
      latest$y_landmark <- as.integer(as.character(data$y[data$week == 26L]))
      deaths <- death[death$event_death == 1L & death$week == 26L, c("id", "tx"), drop = FALSE]
      deaths$y_landmark <- 8L
      landmark <- rbind(latest, deaths)
      landmark$y_landmark <- factor(landmark$y_landmark, levels = 1:8, ordered = TRUE)
      model <- rmsb::blrm(
        formula = y_landmark ~ tx,
        data = landmark,
        chains = 4L,
        iter = 1000L,
        warmup = 500L,
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index)
      )
      if (!requireNamespace("posterior", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'posterior' is required for landmark draws.")
      draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(rmsb::stanGet(model))
      if (nrow(draws) < 200L) stop("Unadjusted landmark posterior has fewer than 200 draws.")
      draws <- as.data.frame(draws[seq_len(200L), , drop = FALSE])
      draws$imputation <- index
      module_save_rds(model, model_path)
      module_save_parquet(draws, draws_path)
    }
  )
}
```
